checks: despite takes nominal short notice and expresses concession; although, even though and because require finite clauses here, and because is causal. Chinese short-notice context repaired to mean little advance notice, not message duration.

activeQuestion.prompt: ____ the short notice, every department submitted its estimate on time.
activeQuestion.promptZh: ____通知得很臨時，各部門仍準時提交估算。

options.whyZh: although 後需完整子句，這裡只有名詞片語。
even though 引導子句，不能直接接 the short notice。
because 後需子句，而且此處語意為逆於不利條件仍完成。
despite 後接名詞片語 the short notice，表達讓步。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: despite 後接名詞片語 the short notice，表達讓步。

vocabulary.note: 距離預定行動的準備時間很短。
